scientific_integrity: An analytical finite-tangent-cone expansion with exact coefficients; high-precision quadrature only supports the rectangle specialization.
scientific_limitations: The error is for each fixed polytope; no uniformity under shape degenerations.
The result concerns uniform points in the full-dimensional interior, not boundary points or random longest-chord sampling.
Leading endpoint powers for some regular polytopes and cubes have existing extreme-value antecedents.
Priority against unindexed older stereological treatments remains to be checked.
title: Two-term diameter-tail expansion for uniform point pairs in convex polytopes
